title: Pigeon, a signed Pass for what a sub-agent may do
summary: Pigeon is a security framework that provides signed passes to control and restrict what actions sub-agents can perform within AI agent systems, essentially serving as a permission and authorization mechanism for multi-agent architectures.
problem_solved: Provides granular access control and permission management for sub-agents to prevent unauthorized actions in AI agent systems.
why_valuable: Enables secure multi-agent deployments by implementing signed permission checks, preventing sub-agents from performing actions outside their defined scope.
